about: Held-out answer key. Never tune Second Read on these files; only score against them.

places.quote: 35 hr/wk, 6 wk/yr
For eight weeks I arrived at 8:30 each morning

mistakes.explanation: The activity lists 6 weeks of research but the essay says the internship lasted eight weeks.

places.quote: Regional Science Fair, 2nd Place in Chemistry
where it took first place in chemistry

mistakes.explanation: The honors list says 2nd place at the regional fair but the essay says the project took first place.

places.quote: I can see myself at Duke

mistakes.explanation: The Rice supplement names a different college, a likely copy-paste slip.

places.quote: an MIT OpenCourseWare lecture on redox reactions

trickyConsistent.why: Another college is named legitimately as the source of a free online lecture, not as the target school.

places.quote: Maine All-State Orchestra, Cello
When I made All-State on viola last year

mistakes.explanation: The honor is for All-State on cello but the essay says the applicant made All-State on viola.

places.quote: Assistant Editor
As editor-in-chief, I read every submission twice

mistakes.explanation: The activity lists the applicant as assistant editor of the magazine but the essay calls them editor-in-chief.

places.quote: Nobody asked what instrument I played. I learned to read a room there in a different way: who needs a second ladle, who is too proud to ask for seconds.
Nobody asked what instrument I played. I learned to read a room there in a different way: who needs a second ladle, who is too proud to ask for seconds.

mistakes.explanation: The same two sentences appear word for word in the personal essay and the supplement.

places.quote: Shift Lead (started as volunteer)
as a Saturday volunteer in tenth grade

trickyConsistent.why: The volunteer-then-shift-lead history is a promotion over time that both the activity and the essay explain.

places.quote: Captain of a 22-player squad in 12th
There's eighteen of us on the roster this year

mistakes.explanation: The activity says the squad has 22 players this year but the essay says the roster is eighteen.

places.quote: Hired summer 2024
since the summer of 2023

mistakes.explanation: The activity says the applicant was hired in summer 2024 but the essay says they have worked there since summer 2023.

places.quote: 12 hr/wk, 40 wk/yr
three nights a week, usually five-hour shifts

mistakes.explanation: Three five-hour shifts a week is about 15 hours, but the activity lists 12 hours per week.

places.quote: Varsity Captain (Center Back)
Freshman year I was on JV and honestly I mostly sat on the bench

trickyConsistent.why: JV and bench time refer to freshman year; varsity captain is the current role, and the essay explains the progression.

places.quote: Lincoln-Douglas Quarterfinalist
Last year I reached the semifinals at the Wisconsin state tournament

mistakes.explanation: The honor says quarterfinalist at state but the essay says the applicant reached the semifinals.

places.quote: Maple County Food Pantry
the Maple Valley Food Bank

mistakes.explanation: The same Wednesday volunteer work is credited to two different organization names.

places.quote: ended after 11th grade to focus on debate
This fall I chaired the Human Rights Council at our school's Model UN conference

mistakes.explanation: The activity says Model UN ended after 11th grade, but the supplement describes chairing a Model UN committee this fall of senior year.

places.quote: 3 hr/wk, 40 wk/yr
Over winter break last year I went in every day

trickyConsistent.why: Daily volunteering is described only for winter break, a different period from the usual weekly schedule.
